parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Nature Farm speaking. How can I help you?

Hi, morning. I’d like to get some information about the part-time job of fruit-picking in the advertisement. I was wondering if you still need some extra hands?

Yes, I do. May I take some of your information first? What’s your name?

Sophie Harris. That’s H-A-R-I-E-S.

Nice to talk with you, Sophie. And where are you currently staying?

Well, I’m from London, but now I’m staying at Central Hostel, Sydney.

Okay, may I have your contact number? I can see from the website your number is 0452 832 727, right?

Oh, sorry. The last digit should be 1, not 7.

Got that. And now, you know we only recruit part-time employees over 18, so could I have your age, please?

I am 18, but I will have my 19th birthday at the end of this month, so you can put 19.

Cool. Happy birthday, Sophie. Well, let’s move on to the real business. We now have two working sites. One is a fruit farm in North Queensland and the other one is near the coast. Which do you prefer?

Er, hmm. I think it will be better if I can spend some time on the beach after work, so I guess the second place sounds best to me.

No problem, Sophie. When do you think you could be ready to join us?

It’s July now, and I’d like to do some travelling around here. What about August?

Yes, August is the busiest month for us. We’re always short of hands.

And, could you please tell me how I will get paid?

We can pay you by every basket of fruits or by the hour. It’s up to you.

You know, I haven’t done fruit picking before, so I guess pay by the hour suits me better.

Okay, I’ve got that. And there are now three types of fruits: bananas, mangoes and avocados. Which fruit would you like to pick?

I prefer mangoes. I think it will be easier for me.

Cool. I’m sure you’ll enjoy that. Okay. Now I’d like to ask you a few more questions about yourself. Do you have any medical problems, like high blood pressure, heart disease or anything like that?

Actually, I just had a medical checkup recently, and everything seemed fine. Well, I hurt my back when I played badminton with my roommate last year, but it’s okay now.

Aha, great. And all of our workers are required to have medical insurance in case people hurt themselves while working, like falling down a ladder. Have you got one now?

Yes, and I definitely hope it won’t happen during working.

Aha, yet you still need to take much care. By the way, do you have a driver’s license? You know the fruit farm is huge. Sometimes you will need to drive a car.

Yes, I got my driver’s license last year, but I’m afraid I don’t have a license for driving large trucks.

No worries. You are not responsible for delivering the picked fruit to the supermarkets. There are some drivers doing that work. And lastly, one more question. Where would you like to live?

Any options for me?

Well, two choices. You can either stay in a cottage on the farm, or we can arrange accommodation in a town nearby.

I don’t think I’d like to stay at the workplace all day long. I think the second one is better for me.

Okay, let’s do that. Looking forward to seeing you soon.

Many thanks. See you then.

analyses.content: Sophie 提到她目前住在悉尼的 Central Hostel。
Well, I’m from London, but now I’m staying at Central Hostel, Sydney。
听到 currently staying 后注意捕捉地点名词。虽然她提到自己来自伦敦，但题目要求的是 Current address。
I am 18, but I will have my 19th birthday at the end of this month, so you can put 19。
典型的数字陷阱。不要填 18，要根据录音中 you can put 19 的明确指令来确定最终答案。
尽管 Sophie 现在 18 岁，但月底就是 19 岁生日，因此工作人员建议直接登记为 19 岁。
One is a fruit farm in North Queensland and the other one is near the coast。
录音中提到了两个地点：North Queensland 和 near the coast。听到 Sophie 说 beach 时要立刻联想到对应的地点是 coast。
Sophie 希望下班后能去沙滩，所以选择了位于 coast（海岸）附近的第二个工作地点。
What about August? Yes, August is the busiest month for us。
排除干扰月份。录音提到了现在是 July，但她实际能够开始工作（Available to work）的时间是下个月 August。
Sophie 计划先旅行一段时间，提议在 August（八月）开始工作，得到了工作人员的确认。
You know, I haven’t done fruit picking before, so I guess pay by the hour suits me better。
录音给出了两种方式：by every basket（按篮）或 by the hour。注意听到 suits me better 之前的选择。
由于没有采摘经验，Sophie 认为按 hour（小时）计费更适合自己。
在香蕉、芒果和牛油果中，Sophie 选择了采摘 mangoes（芒果）。
I prefer mangoes. I think it will be easier for me。
听到三个水果名词并排出现时（bananas, mangoes, avocados），必须等待 Sophie 说出 I prefer... 后的内容。
Well, I hurt my back when I played badminton with my roommate last year, but it’s okay now。
听到 medical checkup 或 medical problems 后定位。虽然她说了 everything seemed fine，但随后的 but 引出了曾经受伤的部位。
Sophie 提到虽然现在好了，但去年打羽毛球时伤到了 back（背部）。
And all of our workers are required to have medical insurance in case people hurt themselves while working。
题干已有 medical，答案只需填核心名词 insurance。注意长单词的拼写准确性。
所有工人都必须有 insurance（医疗保险），Sophie 确认她已经办好了。
...but I’m afraid I don’t have a license for driving large trucks。
听到 driver's license 时注意转折。她有普通的驾照，但缺少的（Doesn't have）是 trucks 的执照。
Sophie 表示她虽然有驾照，但没有驾驶大型 trucks（卡车）的执照。
Well, two choices. You can either stay in a cottage on the farm, or we can arrange accommodation in a town nearby。
两个选项对比：cottage on the farm（农场小屋）和 town nearby。Sophie 明确拒绝了第一个选项。
Sophie 不想整天待在农场，所以选择了住在附近的 town（城镇）。
